local Utils = {}

function Utils.Add(a, b) return a + b end

function Utils.Clamp(x, min, max) return math.max(min, math.min(max, x)) end

function Utils.Lerp(a, b, t) return a + (b - a) * t end

function Utils.Round(x, decimals)
	local m = 10 ^ (decimals or 0)
	return math.floor(x * m + 0.5) / m
end

function Utils.Average(...)
	local t = {...}
	local sum = 0
	for _, v in t do sum += v end
	return sum / #t
end

function Utils.Init()
	print("[MathPlus] OK - Utils chargé via require(script.Utils)")
end

return Utils
